notes:
Lead arrived via self-serve sign-up. Primary product interest: hosted API. Early-stage SMB, trying to add chat + product-recommendation embeddings to their merchant support experience.

Key pain: token costs spiking during POC — large system prompts + verbose examples repeated across calls. Looking for quick wins (reduce per-request tokens) and longer-term config (prefix caching, batching windows).

What they told us (paraphrase / quotes):
- "We get heavy bursts during peak support hours; cost is the biggest unknown right now."
- "Our prompts are templated with 3-4 long examples for few-shot; willing to trade some quality for 30-50% cost savings."

Technical summary (from SE call):
- Avg tokens/request: 1.6k (system + user + conversation history).
- 70% of calls share common product prefix content. Good candidate for prefix/KV caching.
- Real-time latency target: 200-400ms P95 for single-turn responses; throughput modest (20-60 rps bursts).
- Current model: open-model small-medium sized (customer sampled gpt-like open checkpoint). May accept quantized variants.

Requested deliverables:
- Token-usage audit on last 7k calls (identify high-cost prompts).
- Example prompt compression templates and automated rewrite suggestions.
- Suggested batching policy (burst windows) and TTL for prefix caching in hosted API.
- Rough cost-savings estimate with 3 scenarios (conservative/moderate/aggressive).
